headline: De@th toll rises to 13 in Ras Al Khaimah bus and lorry crash
label: NEWS
caption:
Tragic road accident claims lives in the UAE 🇦🇪

The de@th toll from a devastating bus and lorry crash in Ras Al Khaimah has risen to 13 according to reports from The National.

The fatal incident has sparked urgent calls from officials and community members to tackle lorry driver fatigue and boost vehicle maintenance standards.

Authorities are continuing to investigate the circumstances surrounding the collision to prevent future tragedies on the roads.
